component.name: Proccoli
component.summary: Keep an eye on your system's resources

description.p: A system monitor for processors, memory, GPUs, drives, network interfaces and batteries, with tables of running apps and processes.
The GPU page adapts to the GPU: on Intel GPUs it shows per-engine utilisation, frequency, power, RC6 residency, memory bandwidth and per-process engine usage from intel_gpu_top.
Runs on Ubuntu 24.04, adds NVIDIA statistics and keeps a record of every reading.

ul.li: Fixed: Proccoli wouldn't start on Ubuntu 24.04
NVIDIA graphics: live usage and a Details tab, from nvidia-settings or nvidia-smi
A device that can't be read shows an error page with Try Again
The sidebar can show icons only
Processor: one chart with a line per core and a legend; click to hide a core, right-click to show only it
The Overview opens at every start and shows temperatures and graphics memory
Graphs show a chosen time range, whatever the refresh speed
Every reading is saved to files, with UTC times; the log uses UTC too
